title: 相變化記憶體製作
summary: 從相態與電阻、脈衝能量到陣列耐久度：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Phase and resistance and Pulse energy to Array endurance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 相態與電阻 → 加熱器幾何
stages.titleEn: Phase and resistance to Heater geometry
stages.description: 把「相態與電阻」「SET 與 RESET」「加熱器幾何」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Phase and resistance, SET and RESET, Heater geometry.

steps.title: 相態與電阻：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Phase and resistance: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture.
steps.instruction: 畫晶態及非晶態原子示意，連結到兩組假設電阻分布。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch crystalline/amorphous arrangements and connect them to resistance distributions. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。
steps.observationEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
steps.failure: 若採用「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「相態與電阻」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Phase and resistance diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「相變化記憶體製作」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「相態與電阻：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：兩個電阻狀態不代表熱路徑與多位準穩定已驗證。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「記憶與感光：讀出、保持與雜訊」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：相變化記憶體製作 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「兩個電阻狀態不代表熱路徑與多位準穩定已驗證」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Phase-change memory fabrication as the task boundary. After reading “Phase and resistance: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Two resistance states do not validate thermal paths or multilevel stability. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Memory and sensing: readout, retention and noise”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Phase-change memory fabrication: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Two resistance states do not validate thermal paths or multilevel stability” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「相態與電阻」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Phase and resistance, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路
把高阻態都視為燒斷導線
只比較最大脈衝幅度判斷最終相態
optionsEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture
Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire
Judging final phase from maximum pulse amplitude alone
quiz.explanation: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 相態與電阻：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Phase and resistance: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「相態與電阻」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Phase and resistance artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Read bias should avoid reheating the state. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。
steps.observationEn: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
steps.failure: 若採用「把高阻態都視為燒斷導線」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「相態與電阻」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Phase and resistance, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Read bias should avoid reheating the state" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 相態與電阻／驗證與限制

knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Treating every high-resistance state as a burnt wire" is not equivalent to "Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.observationEn: Peak temperature and cooling history jointly determine phase; Cooling rate affects amorphization.
